about: Synthetic Finance accounts-payable inbox for the ap_inbox skill. Proves the triage engine is reusable: same code, different spec. Vendors are fictional on .example domains. 'expect' keys: a list means any listed value passes; '<field>_includes' means the answer's list must contain these items.

messages.subject: Invoice INV-20417 from Northwind Cloud Services
messages.body:
Hello,

Please find attached invoice INV-20417 for September platform usage.

Amount due: USD 12,400.00
PO: PO-7781
Terms: Net 30

Thank you for your business.
Northwind Cloud Services, Billing

messages.subject: PAST DUE: Invoice 1182
messages.body:
Our records show invoice 1182 for $3,870.00 is now 45 days past due. Please remit payment within 5 business days or contact us to discuss. Continued non-payment may result in suspension of janitorial service.

Contoso Facilities, Accounts Receivable

messages.subject: Updated banking details - action required before next payment
messages.body:
Dear AP team,

Due to an audit with our previous bank, Northwind Cloud Services has moved accounts. Please update our remittance details before you pay INV-20417:

Bank: First Coastal Trust
Routing: 021000089
Account: 4471902265

Payments to the old account will be returned. Please confirm once updated.

Regards,
Northwind Cloud Services Finance
messages.note: Business email compromise with a lookalike domain (northwind-billing.example, not northwind.example).

messages.subject: FYI: remittance update
messages.body:
Hi team, quick housekeeping note. As part of our treasury consolidation, our ACH remittance account is changing next month. New routing and account numbers are in the attached letter. Please use these for all payments going forward. Nothing else changes.

Thanks!
Northwind Billing
messages.note: Bank change from the real domain, framed as routine. Still requires a callback: the mailbox itself may be compromised.

messages.subject: Payment received - INV-5520
messages.body:
Thank you. We have received your payment of $8,215.50 for invoice INV-5520. No further action is needed.

Fabrikam Logistics

messages.subject: Status of invoice 3391?
messages.body:
Hi there, could you let me know when invoice 3391 ($2,600) will be paid? It was due September 30 and I haven't seen a payment yet. Thanks so much.

Grace
Litware Design Studio

messages.subject: Credit memo CM-88
messages.body:
Hello, we overbilled your September seat count. Attached is credit memo CM-88 for $1,150.00, which will apply to your next invoice automatically.

Adatum Billing

messages.subject: Team lunch Friday
messages.body: Lunch is on us Friday at noon in the big conference room. Reply with any dietary restrictions!

messages.subject: New vendor setup - W-9 and payment information
messages.body:
Hello! We're excited to start working together. Attached are our W-9 and ACH payment information for vendor setup in your system. Our first invoice will follow next week.

Proseware Analytics Finance

messages.subject: Urgent wire - confidential
messages.body:
I need a wire of $48,000 sent today to close an acquisition deposit. I'm in back-to-back board meetings, so don't call, just email me when it's done. Keep this confidential until we announce.

Dana Whitfield
CEO, OurCo
messages.note: CEO impersonation: personal Gmail, secrecy, 'don't call'. The callback rule exists for exactly this.
